description: Run the AI-search hygiene checks on a public URL. A grade is not a citation and does not measure AI mentions. Free callers get per-group grades plus every failed fundamental (readiness levels L0-L3) with how to fix it; Pro/Team callers also get rule IDs, severity and evidence for every check, plus a work list ordered by weight. propose is always true: each fix is a proposal for a person to apply. Free results may be cached for up to an hour; keyed scans always fetch the page fresh. Batched callers pass detail=failures to drop passing checks. A page whose robots.txt disallows it for aeogeo-scanner is not fetched (blocked_url). The checks cover technical readiness only; each result says what a full audit adds in semantic_review (guidance.semantic_review on keyed page scans). Use when: The page is already public and you want the bytes a crawler receives. Avoid when: The draft is only local. Use lint_html for HTML, lint_text for markdown, or audit_schema for JSON-LD. content_type is an argument on those tools and on scan_url, not a separate tool. Do not claim: A grade or a pass is not a citation. The check says the page matches the rulebook. Verify: Deploy the edit, then call scan_url again. A keyed scan fetches fresh. judge: engine — trust the pass/fail from the deterministic check (access, rendering, and mechanical structure). judge: agent — your agent re-reads the rule text and decides; the label comes from the deterministic judgeForCheck mapping, not an LLM on our side.

content_type.description: Optional. What the page is, for pages that declare no schema.org @type or og:type. Without it the scanner infers the type and, when it cannot, skips the type-specific checks with a reason.

detail.description: Keyed callers only; a free scan already lists failures alone and ignores it. full (default): every check. failures: only failed and skipped checks plus the page and group grades, grade_basis and the do-not-claim guidance — use it for batched calls or when a full response would be truncated.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL to scan.

name: scan_url
title: Scan a page
